source: tl-squadds deploy/registry.yaml (version 2), flagship_tiers accurate/fast (served as models qcap/qcap-fast), paper_hub.prior_stacks corrected

corrected.title: corrected prior with substrate far field
corrected.value_changing_approved: user 2026-10-17 (v2m, gnn_models.GNN); user 2026-10-20: adopted arm (b) of agents/farfield (substrate dipole for far pairs in different ground pockets; pre-declared rule met, agents/farfield/RESULTS.md; adoption agents/farfield/ADOPTION.md)

qcap.title: QCap (~1 s): extrapolated physics R(1.5, 3) on the corrected prior + residual networks, compiled solver
qcap.summary: Two thin-film method-of-moments solves (corrected prior with substrate far field, 1.5 and 3 panels per gap), Richardson-extrapolated, corrected by a 3-seed ensemble of residual networks (89,858 parameters per seed, bounded residual) with a learned row-sum closure: the complete Maxwell matrix, self terms included. Networks retrained on all 45,771 on-stack Q3D layouts (2026-10-20, on the corrected prior with substrate far field).

reference.recipe: the paper's version of this model (same architecture and prior stack at inference; its networks were trained on the 35,354 TRAIN layouts only, on the uncorrected prior; retrained on the corrected prior, as here, they score validation 0.218 % (0.0774 / 0.0888 fF)). These held-out numbers belong to the paper's version, not to this release, whose networks were retrained on every labelled design, the paper's test split included

insample.set: in-sample, all 45,771 training layouts (TRAIN + VAL + the paper's test split; it was trained on them)

qcap.time_space: interdigital 0.47 s, xmon 0.91 s, 1-qubit lattice (N 15) 19.0 s, 16-conductor layout 9.9 s, 9-qubit lattice (N 67) 154 s (server time, one request, Docker build 2026-10-20; a repeated request is answered from the cache in ~0.01 s)
qcap.time_x86: 0.845 / 5.96 s in family, 1.75 / 18.1 s zero-shot (median / p90; x86 cluster, 2 CPUs); B5 0.99 s median (1.14 s on the 2026-10-20 re-run, Xeon E5-2640 v4)

qcap-fast.title: QCap-Fast (~0.1 s): learned prior surrogate + residual networks, no field solve (trained component families only)
qcap-fast.summary: An improved release of the paper's fast model, same architecture: a learned surrogate (1.02M parameters) predicts the two uncorrected-prior solves at 1.5 and 3 panels per gap and residual networks correct them. The surrogate is trained on more generated layouts (the prior of every on-stack layout plus 432,697 generated layouts labelled by the prior alone, against 385,593 for the paper's) and the networks are retrained on every labelled design (all 45,771 on-stack layouts, the paper's test split included). No field solve: the time is the geometric embedding.
qcap-fast.warning: Use QCap-Fast only for quick screening of the component families it was trained on (interdigital, paddle, concentric, star, multipad star, Xmon, TransmonPocket, shielded concentric, two-net, random, procedurally generated and synthetic campaign layouts). On new designs of a trained family (B5) it was worse than the physics alone, 3.175 % (MAE 0.583 / RMSE 0.824 fF) against 1.765 % (0.275 / 0.376 fF), and the paper's version of it was worse than the physics alone on a held-out family too, 3.11 % (0.533 / 0.633 fF) against 1.55 % (0.166 / 0.205 fF). Use QCap for anything that matters.

reference.recipe: the paper's version of the fast model (surrogate t100_norm trained on 385,593 generated layouts + the TRAIN geometry; networks trained on the 35,354 TRAIN layouts only). These held-out numbers belong to the paper's version, not to this release, which was trained on the paper's test split too

val_same_surrogate.note: this release's surrogate recipe trained without the validation layouts (P6 SUR-ALL) + the paper's TRAIN-only networks, held out (agents/surcov_p6/RESULTS_P6.md)

insample.set: in-sample, all 45,771 training layouts (TRAIN + VAL + the paper's test split; it was trained on them)

b5_physics.name: physics alone C^R = R(1.5, 3) (worse than the physics: QCap-Fast is behind it here)

qcap-fast.time_space: interdigital 0.036 s, xmon 0.11 s, 1-qubit lattice (N 15) 0.82 s, 16-conductor layout 0.49 s, 9-qubit lattice (N 67) 3.9 s (server time, one request, Docker build 2026-10-20; a repeated request is answered from the cache in ~0.01 s)
